Frequently.title: What is Web3 wallet development?
Frequently.desc: Web3 wallet development involves creating decentralized wallets that allow users to store, manage, and trade cryptocurrencies, NFTs, and digital assets securely without relying on intermediaries. These wallets interact directly with blockchain networks using smart contracts.

Frequently.title: How long does it take to build a Web3 wallet?
Frequently.desc: The development timeline depends on the features, blockchain integrations, and customization level. On average, a custom Web3 wallet takes 6 to 12 weeks from design to deployment.

Frequently.title: Which blockchains are supported?
Frequently.desc: Comfygen supports major blockchains, including Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain (BSC), Polygon, Solana, Avalanche, and Tron, ensuring seamless multi-chain wallet experiences.

Frequently.title: How do you ensure wallet security?
Frequently.desc: We implement AES and SHA-256 encryption, multi-signature authentication, private key encryption, and AI-powered security audits to ensure complete data protection.

Frequently.title: Can you integrate DeFi and NFTs?
Frequently.desc: Yes. Our wallets support DeFi staking, token swaps, liquidity pools, and NFT minting, trading, and marketplace integration, enabling a complete decentralized finance and digital asset experience.
